datasets.name: Selected ICAR Data from the SAPA-Project
datasets.redistribution: Do not commit the third-party raw dataset into this repository; obtain it from the cited repository and process locally.
limitations: Convenience sample, not a representative population norm.
Sparse SAPA administration: participants answered random subsets rather than all 60 items.
External data cannot be merged into Cognitive IQ Lab product norms.

datasets.name: OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC)
datasets.population: adult probability samples across participating countries
datasets.access: Public Use Files require acceptance of OECD terms and may require research/institution information.
limitations: Do not automate around OECD access terms.
Do not redistribute restricted or terms-bound microdata.
Not item-equivalent to Cognitive IQ Lab.

datasets.name: OECD PISA cognitive item data
limitations: Population does not match the Cognitive IQ Lab adult 18-65 scope.
Use only for method stress-testing, never adult norming.
